descriptor.label: Apache Arrow / Parquet
descriptor.description: Export the types as Apache Arrow schemas (the JSON integration form) and the Parquet message each becomes: one table per root record, with nested structs, lists, maps and unions, and logical types for dates, timestamps, decimals and UUIDs.

table.description: Export only this record (its name or key) as the table. Empty means every root record (a record no other record holds), each as its own schema.
table.title: Table

output.description: What to write for each table: `arrow` (an Arrow schema, plus its Parquet message), `bigquery` (a BigQuery table schema, the JSON `bq mk --schema` reads) or `spark` (a Spark StructType DDL string, what `DataType.fromDDL` parses). All three serialize the same typed projection.
output.title: Output

parquet.description: Also write each table's Parquet message (`<table>.parquet.txt`), as pyarrow derives it (output `arrow` only).
parquet.title: Parquet

bundle.description: Output `bigquery` / `spark`: write every table into one file (`schemas.bigquery.json`, an object of table → schema; `schemas.spark.ddl`, a `-- <table>` line before each DDL line) instead of one file per table.
bundle.title: Bundle

indent.description: JSON indentation width (0 for compact output).
indent.title: Indent
